project_type: Go rules engine with gateway/worker architecture, deployed on Kubernetes
build_system: Go modules (go.mod in engine/), Makefile at root
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'go build ./cmd/engine && go build ./cmd/worker' to verify compilation. 2. Run 'go test ./internal/gateway/... ./internal/worker/...' for unit tests. 3. Run 'kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f deploy/' to validate YAML files.
environment_constraints: All work in worktree at /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase5. Go module root is engine/ subdirectory. Use absolute paths. Commit locally, never push.
contribution_requirements: Record verification results in /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.agents/tasks/dynamic-grouped-workers/phase5/verification.md. No breaking changes to existing Phase 4 metrics.

key_patterns.metrics: Use prometheus/client_golang with NewCounterVec, NewHistogramVec, NewGaugeVec. Register on prometheus.Registerer. See internal/gateway/metrics.go and internal/observ/metrics.go for patterns.
key_patterns.tracing: OTEL is already set up in internal/observ/tracer.go. Use otelTracer.StartSpan(). Use TraceIDFromContext() for trace ID extraction. Propagate via X-Request-Id, X-Trace-Id, traceparent headers.
key_patterns.logging: Use observ.Logger.Emit(ctx, level, label, fields). JSON format. Include request_id, trace_id, group in all log lines. See internal/observ/logger.go.
key_patterns.templates: K8s templates in internal/gateway/templates/*.yaml.tmpl using text/template and //go:embed. See manifests.go.

relevant_files: engine/internal/gateway/metrics.go - Phase 4 gateway metrics to enhance
engine/internal/gateway/dispatcher.go - Dispatch flow, needs tracing spans
engine/internal/gateway/scaler.go - Scale operations, needs cold start timing
engine/internal/gateway/client.go - Worker HTTP client, needs trace propagation
engine/internal/gateway/circuit.go - Circuit breaker, expose state to metrics
engine/internal/worker/handler.go - Worker HTTP handler, needs trace extraction

directory_structure.engine/internal/gateway/: Gateway dispatcher, registry, scaler, metrics, manifests
